caption: The drawing depicts an ornate tabletop mirror with a decorative frame and stand. The mirror itself is oval and appears to have a reflective surface with light blue and white tones indicating reflection or glare. The frame is highly detailed, featuring brown and gold hues with intricate designs of leaves, vines, and clusters of grapes entwined around the mirror and stand. The base of the mirror is similarly elaborate, with scrollwork and symmetrical motifs. Both the frame and base have a metallic or bronze-like appearance with subtle hints of green patina. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the mirror and its ornate details. The artist's name, "DANA BARTLETT," is signed in the bottom right corner.
title: Shaving Mirror
